description: Baseline for every chiva repo: one weekly batch, green non-major updates merge themselves, majors wait for a human.

packageRules.description: One PR for every non-major update. Groups declared later (by presets or the repo) take precedence.
Merge once the repo's required checks pass. Majors are left out on purpose. Safe only because github-infra enforces required checks on every default branch.

Actions are pinned to the digest of a full semver tag, so a new release arrives as a minor/patch update with its own release age. A digest-only update means an existing tag now points at different code, the signature of a hijacked tag, or an action tracked by branch moved: a human looks at it. Its own group, because one manual update in the non-major group would disable automerge for the whole batch.

Actions tracked by branch (# main / # master) can only update by digest, so a new digest is routine, not a moved tag. From trusted Home Assistant ecosystem orgs they merge themselves, in their own group so a manual tag digest never holds them back. Accepted risk: a compromised default branch of these orgs runs in CI, including on main.
